title: InterviewSession
description: Canonical shape for an interview session passed between AI engine, report generator, and frontend. All teammates should agree on changes before modifying.

session_id.description: Unique identifier for this interview session

patient_id.description: Optional patient identifier (may be anonymous at interview time)

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the session was started

status.description: Current lifecycle state of the session

transcript.description: Ordered list of turns in the interview conversation

triage.description: TODO: AI - populate after session completes

report_id.description: TODO: Report - set once report_generator.generate() runs

booking_id.description: TODO: Scheduling - set once an appointment is booked
